content: {"episode_id":"ep-05012","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for CPT 93229, which was denied because required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias. Given the patient's personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, the note indicates prolonged ambulatory monitoring to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk."}
